page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfc5.4xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated physical cores of the x86_64 Intel Xeon 6149 processor, operating at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The system is configured with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core performance. Single-core metrics, such as stress-ng single-core CPU performance and Geekbench single-core scores, fall into the bottom 25% tier. However, multi-core performance scales to average levels, as demonstrated by the stress-ng multi-core CPU score of 14404.28 and a Passmark CPU score of 15463.52. Memory bandwidth is stable, with read-only small block cached speeds reaching 804.1 GB/sec and uncached large block write speeds at 38.81 GB/sec.

The lack of local storage and weak single-core execution speeds represent notable tradeoffs. However, the instance performs reliably in multi-threaded tasks, achieving average ratings in software compilation, ray tracing, and Redis SET operations at 13.86 million operations per second. This hardware profile is suited for multi-threaded workloads, static web serving, and database operations that do not require high single-thread performance or local NVMe storage.
